name: Casting Conduit [Teamwork]
body:
You are a conduit to spells, able to convey magic to an enemy you can touch, even if it is not your own.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 1 rank.

Benefit(s): When an ally is casting a spell with a range of touch that deals hit point damage, they can target you if you are willing and adjacent. You take the minimum damage from the spell, and as an immediate action the can make a touch attack against an adjacent foe to deliver the spell. If this attack hits, the spell deals its normal damage to the opponent. If you have the grappled or pinned condition, the spell is automatically transferred to the grappling or grappled foe with no attack roll needed. This ability has no effect if you are immune to the spell’s effect (such as shocking grasp delivered to an ally immune to electricity).
